messages:
marco: Quick follow-up on the authz postmortem. We had a namespace-regex regression in the secrets-rotation lambda and audit telemetry gaps. I want a compact action list with owners + dates.

anya: TL;DR: rotation lambda skipped namespaces that matched old naming; two tokens exceeded TTL and caused degraded auth for metrics and billing. We need: guardrail checks, canary runs, audit exports, and runbook steps.

lee: I'll take the rotation hardening (T-901). Plan: add preflight namespace validator, idempotent runs, and a canary flag that targets 3 non-prod namespaces. ETA 2026-04-04.

marco: I'll own the audit exports + TTL guard (T-902). Proposal: daily export of token inventory to S3 (csv), with a nightly job that flags tokens ttl>45d and writes a remediation row. Draft infra Terraform by 2026-03-29.

ops-bot: Created tasks on board: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/rot-ttl-guards  (T-901, T-902, T-903).

anya: I'll do the runbook + emergency shortcut (T-903). Runbook should include: how to run canary, how to force-rotate a token, verification steps (auth smoke tests), and rollback. Draft by 2026-03-27.

lee: Manual remediation tonight: svc-observe rotated ok, svc-billing rotated ok, svc-metrics failed until we remapped secret path. Logs: ```rotate svc-observe -> ok
rotate svc-billing -> ok
rotate svc-metrics -> failed: secret path /secret/legacy/metrics not found```

security-eng: I'm scanning for legacy secret paths and tokens with ttl>45d. Will attach CSV to the ticket and mark blockers. Also proposing a policy: no token TTL > 90d without explicit exception.

marco: For the TTL guard I'm adding a temporary alert: token_inventory_daily:count_where(ttl_days>45) > 0 -> pager to sec-team and owner. Include exemption annotation handling.

lee: I'll add rotation metrics: rotations_total{status="success"} and rotations_total{status="fail"} plus rotation_missed_namespaces gauge. CI e2e will inject a bad regex and expect rotation_missed_namespaces>0 to fail the job. PR 4622.

anya: Manual remediations completed after infra remap. Final logs: ```rotate svc-observe ok
rotate svc-billing ok
rotate svc-metrics ok```

incident-bot: Updated board and linked postmortem: https://redwood.link/pm-authz-2026. Follow-up sync Fri 2026-04-02 09:00 PT (15m). Target remediation close by 2026-04-15 if audits pass.

marco: Ownership summary: T-901 -> lee -> 2026-04-04; T-902 -> marco -> draft infra 2026-03-29; T-903 -> anya -> 2026-03-27. Ping here to reassign. Thanks everyone.
